messages:
sara: Noticing weird attach backoffs in ap-southeast1 during nightly ephemeral GC - about 8/320 nodes showing transient nvme stalls.

ben: Logs? attach errors or just timeouts?

sara: dmesg shows controller resets and a lot of write amplification warnings from the cleaner job. Example: 

ben: ```
[ 4521.123456] nvme0n1: write timeout, driver reset
[ 4521.123789] nvme0: ctrl: reset start
```

jia: These hosts are mixed 1TB/2TB but the pattern skews to the older 1TB cohort (serial prefix AX9). Cleaner tuning rolled yesterday increased aggressive coalescing.

ops-oncall: infra-bot: reduce new GPU scheduling weight in ap-southeast1 to 0.5 until mitigation.

infra-bot: Action: routing weight ap-southeast1=0.5 -> reason: nvme-attach-stalls.

sara: Quick mitigation: rollback coalesce changes, set cleaner concurrency to 1 for AX9 nodes, and mark them avoid-for-provisioning.

ben: Also add provisioner retry on "nvme reset" logs and fallback host selection after 2 retries. I'll draft a small retry patch.

jia: I'll collect SMART and nvme-cli counters and open a vendor ticket for FW 2.9.4 cohort. Early SMART shows no reallocated sectors yet.

deploy-bot: Heads-up: planned kernel update to 5.10.130 in 4h for this region. Consider delaying.

ops-oncall: Hold the kernel roll. I'll update infra-schedule and cost ops: routing increases cross-region churn ~ $1k/day if prolonged.

sara: Thanks. Will monitor attach latencies post-change and post telemetry. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
